about: The Preface of the Most Holy Trinity. It confesses one God in three Persons, without confusion of Persons or division of substance, and leads into the common song with the choirs of angels.

seg.nr: Then the priest separates his hands and holds them apart until the end of the Preface. When it is finished, he joins them again and, bowing, says: Sanctus.

seg.tr: It is truly meet and just, right and profitable for salvation, that we should at all times and in all places give thanks unto Thee:
O holy Lord, Father almighty, eternal God:
Who, with Thine only-begotten Son and the Holy Ghost, art one God and one Lord: not in the oneness of a single Person, but in the Trinity of one substance.
For that which, by Thy revelation, we believe of Thy glory, the same we understand of Thy Son and the same of the Holy Ghost, without difference arising from distinction.
So that, in the confession of the true and eternal Godhead, distinction in Persons, unity in essence, and equality in majesty may be adored.
This equality the Angels and Archangels, the Cherubim also and the Seraphim praise; they cease not daily to cry out with one voice, saying:
